data.text:
S.Govind Reddy vs The State Of Telangana, on 26 July, 2024
 The Hon'Ble Sri Justice C.V. Bhaskar Reddy
 Writ Petition No.37164 of 2015
Order: 
This writ petition is filed seeking the following relief:
"....to issue a Writ, Order or Direction more particularly one in the nature of Writ of Mandamus declaring the impugned proceedings of the 3rd respondent vide proceedings No.AMCG/Legal/2015-16/577, dated 27.10.2015, the allotment of premises shop No.B-21 at Fruit Market, Gaddiannaram, Hyderabad, has been cancelled as illegal, improper, contrary to law, violative of principles of natural justice and consequently set aside the same..." 
2. The petitioner claims to have been allotted shop No.B-21 in fruit market, Gaddiannaram. The case of the petitioner is that he obtained license under Section 7 of the Andhra Pradesh (Agricultural Produce and Livestocks) Markets Act, 1966 (for short 'the Act') and acting as a commission agent on behalf of growers in getting agricultural produce sold out for a reasonable price on the commission fixed by the market committee.
3. While the matter stood thus, a show cause notice was issued to the petitioner vide proceedings No.AMCG/Legal/ 2015-16/397, dated 19.08.2015, stating that the petitioner has indulged in using Calcium Carbide Powder in the packed Sapota boxes and the said stock was seized by the Revenue officials, Food and Safety Officials, Police Officials and Marketing Officials, after conducting panchanama on the ground that using Calcium Carbide Powder in Fruit Packing along with quick ripening of fruits is hazardous to public health and called for an explanation, for cancellation of license. 
4. Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that initially petitioner has submitted explanation to the said show cause notice on 24.08.2015 and thereafter, respondents have issued another show cause notice dated 11.09.2015 and the said show cause notice has not been served on the petitioner and stating that petitioner has not submitted any explanation to the second show cause notice, the impugned proceedings dated 27.10.2015 have been issued to the petitioner. 
5. Learned Standing Counsel appearing for the petitioner submits that pending adjudication of the Writ Petition, old fruit market which is existing in Gaddiannaram has been shifted to new place i.e.,
Batasingaram. He further submits that taking into consideration the eligibility and fulfillment of requirements as per the provisions of the Act and Rules made thereunder, shops were allotted to eligible licensees. 
6. In view of shifting of existing market in Gaddiannaram to new place at Batasingaram, if the petitioner is otherwise eligible as per the rules framed by the Government, petitioner is permitted to S.Govind Reddy vs The State Of Telangana, on 26 July, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/135209449/
1 make appropriate application on the file of the respondents and on filing such application,
respondents are directed to consider the same and pass appropriate orders in accordance with law. 
7. With the above direction, this Writ Petition is disposed of. There shall be no order as to costs. 
8. Miscellaneous Petitions, if any, pending in this writ petition shall stand closed. 
___ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ ____ C.V. BHASKAR REDDY, J Date: 26.07.2024 vsl/prn S.Govind Reddy vs The State Of Telangana, on 26 July, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/135209449/
